<!--
This template nudges issues toward "ready-to-pull": well-specified enough that
someone (or a coding agent) can open a mergeable PR with no further clarification.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full criteria. Keep it to ONE deliverable per issue —
split "and also…" work into separate issues.

If the change touches copy, navigation or page structure, check it against the
Purpose section of README.md first — that's the yardstick for what goes on the site.
-->

<!-- One sentence: the single change this issue delivers. The title should name it. -->

netlify/functions/calendar.js. "I'm not sure" is a sign this may not be ready yet. -->

## Proposed approach

<!-- How you'd do it: numbered steps, the shape of the fix, or constraints/invariants

## Acceptance criteria / verification

<!-- How we know it's done. Playwright tests to add or keep green, the build and
pre-commit hooks passing, Lighthouse thresholds held, observed-vs-expected resolved,
which page/viewport to check by eye. -->
